verdict.rationale: Supabase documents an official hosted MCP server (https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp, OAuth-protected Streamable HTTP) and a local endpoint via the CLI. It has rich tool groups for database, debugging, Edge Functions, account and docs, plus per-connection scoping (project_ref, read_only, features), per-agent setup guides and a one-command plugin install. Community discussion concerns prompt-injection risk when using it against production, not whether it works, and actually reflects real-world use. Missing for 10: fine-grained PAT scopes (all scopes currently required for CI), branching tools are still experimental.
